control_profile: Exact target-sign inversion of the frozen baseline with identical volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, position stop and turnover cap.
falsifier: If the exact inversion materially outperforms the baseline, the declared long-low-funding and short-high-funding carry sign is wrong; symmetric weakness instead confirms the sign while exposing price-risk defects.
formation_horizon: robust seven-day and twenty-eight-day settled-funding estimates with a nine-bar residual price state
hypothesis: Negating every scheduled baseline target provides a clean funding-direction diagnostic without changing selection, scale, holding schedule or controls.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort with three equally weighted overlapping cohorts
